status: registered before any result of this search was computed; committed alone, before the code that runs it
why: The 1-minute plan menu had no edge before costs (every plan hit at its coin-flip rate) and costs were ~1/3 of an hour's move. Two levers are left: a longer horizon, where costs are a few percent of a move, and plans built on a tendency the market might actually have (trend at multi-day horizons, reversion after extremes). Both need years of data, which 4-hour bars give.

data.bars: 4h candles, Hyperliquid candleSnapshot, 5000 per asset, 2024-06-21 to 2026-10-03, cached under lab/fixtures/candles-<coin>-4h.json
data.dev_period: the first 60% of bars (3000 bars, to about 2025-08-11)
data.warmup: a plan needs 200 bars of history before its first decision; the validation walk may read dev-period bars for its indicators but starts deciding at the boundary

costs.funding_note: a constant long-pays rate, the 21-day BTC mean; real funding varies and alts are often higher. A known simplification.

families.breakout: close above the previous N bars' high: buy at the next open (below their low: sell). Exit by a trailing stop k*sigma_N behind the extreme since entry, no target, at most 3N bars.
families.momentum: the N-bar return beyond 1 sigma_N: trade in its direction at the next open. Exit by a trailing stop k*sigma_N, no target, at most N bars.
families.reversion: close at least zt standard deviations from its N-bar mean (sd of that gap = sigma1*sqrt(N/3)): trade back toward the mean. Target the mean at entry, stop 1 sigma_N beyond the entry, at most N bars.

sigma: sigma1 = sd of the last 120 bar log returns; sigma_N = sigma1*sqrt(N)
walk: one plan at a time per asset; when a strategy has no signal it waits one bar. Every trade is scored after all costs.
statistic: t = mean net per trade / its standard error, pooled over the assets in the set
selection_on_dev: a configuration SURVIVES if, on the dev assets over the dev period, net > 0 and t >= 2.77 (one-sided p = 0.05/18, Bonferroni for 18 trials). If none survives the search is reported as failed; the best by dev t is still carried to validation, labelled as having failed selection.
confirmation: each survivor is CONFIRMED if net > 0 and t >= 1.645 / Bonferroni over survivors (one-sided p = 0.05/m for m survivors) in BOTH (a) dev assets over the validation period and (b) holdout assets over the validation period. Holdout assets over the dev period are reported but not used for any decision.
beta_check: for each confirmed strategy, report longs and shorts separately and buy-and-hold over the same period. A strategy whose whole profit is longs in a rising market is labelled beta, not edge.
no_amendment: the grid, splits, costs and thresholds above are not changed after results are seen. Anything run after this is reported as exploratory, with its trial count.
then: confirmed strategies (or, if none, the best) become plan menu v2 alongside wait, each option carrying its own trailing record; Jev chooses on the validation period, scored against always taking the strategy's signal, random over the same menu, and wait.
